dedupe_keys.name: computational package for operational co flow optimization of a serviceable space data center binding capacities and marginal values at fixed designs

description: A University of Vigo team publishes code and an input workbook for a one-day operational co-flow model of a proposed space data centre. Zenodo provides a ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The package models fixed radiator, solar-array, battery, buffer and compute-unit designs with a cyclic linear programme; dual values estimate the marginal contribution of capacity changes. The description reports experiments across four designs, eight campaign years and three demand multipliers. This model can test coupled heat, power and compute constraints in future space-infrastructure concepts. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. Coverage is a hypothetical reference design, not a commissioned orbital facility. A limitation is that design optimisation, logistics and uncertainty are assigned to a separate study, so the package addresses only the fixed-design operational level. The archive was not downloaded, its workbook was not inspected and no solver result was reproduced.
